questions.question: Identify the foreigner who has been conferred the second highest civilian award in India, Padma Vibhushan for 'exceptional and distinguished service' in 2019.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Ismail Omar Guelleh**__ has been conferred the second highest civilian award in India, Padma Vibhushan for 'exceptional and distinguished service' in 2019. 
 
• The other recipients include Teejan Bai, Anilkumar Manibhai Naik, and Balwant Moreshwar Purandare.
 
• A total of 112 awardees were selected for Padma Vibhushan, Padma Bhushan and Padma Shri awards.

questions.question: Who was the Indian Army Chief at the time of Bangladesh Liberation War?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Sam Manekshaw**__ was the Indian Army Chief at the time of Bangladesh Liberation War.
 
• He was also the Chief of the Army Staff during Indo-Pakistani War 1971.
 
• He began his service in World War II in the British Army.

questions.question: The summer solstice 2019 in the Northern Hemisphere will occur on ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The summer solstice 2019 in the Northern Hemisphere will occur on** 21 June 2019.**__
 
• It is the longest day of the year.
 
• The winter solstice in the Southern Hemisphere will occur on 22 December 2019.

questions.question: Jorwe culture was a Chalcolithic archaeological site located in the present day Indian state of ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Jorwe culture was a Chalcolithic archaeological site located in the present day Indian state of **Maharashtra**__.
 
• It further spread to north in the Malwa region (Madhya Pradesh).
 
• Its early phase dates back to 1400-1000 BCE, while its later one from 1000-700 BCE.

questions.question: Fertile riverine alluvial soil is best suited for producing ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Fertile riverine alluvial soil is best suited for producing sugarcane, **rice**__, and plantain.
 
• Alluvial soil is rich in potassium.
 
• Red soil is ideal for crops like corn, red gram, Bengal gram, green gram, groundnut, and castor seed
 
• Laterite soil is ideal for growing tea.

questions.question: Who among the following was named as the Chief Executive Officer of International Cricket Council (ICC) in January 2019?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Manu Sawhney**__ was named as the Chief Executive Officer of International Cricket Council (ICC) in January 2019.
 
• He was working alongside Dave Richardson, who stepped down in July 2019 after the World Cup.
 
• Manu Sawhney is the former ESPN Star Sports Managing Director.

questions.question: The energy derived from the heat of Earth is called ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The energy derived from the heat of Earth is called **geothermal energy.**__
 
• It comes from the heat within the earth.
 
• Solar energy is derived from the sun.
 
• Biogas is derived from the organic matter.
 
• Tidal energy is obtained from tides and is a form of hydropower.

questions.question: Which of the following creatures is oviparous?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Oviparous animals**__ are those which lay eggs.
 
• Examples of Oviparous animals include birds, reptiles, amphibians, fish, etc.
 
• Viviparous animals give birth to completely developed living young animals. examples- cattle, human, etc.

questions.question: Which of the following acids is present in ant bites?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Formic acid**__ is present in ant bites.
 
• The sting of an ant contains simple carboxylic acid, which is also known as formic acid.
 
• The same acid is present in the sting of wasps, bees, etc.
 
• The chemical formula of formic acid is H-COOH.

• The other 2 main stars are Alpha Centauri A and Alpha Centauri B, which are 4.3 light years away from the earth.

questions.question: In which year was the East India Company incorporated for the exploitation of trade with East and Southeast Asia and India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The East India Company incorporated for the exploitation of trade with East and Southeast Asia and India in the year **1600**__.
 
• It started as a monopolistic trading body but became involved in politics from early 18th century.

questions.question: The demand for a commodity or service which is a consequence of the demand for something else is called ______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **The demand for a commodity or service which is a consequence of the demand for something else is called derived demand.**__
 
• Eg.** When we purchase a laptop, we demand a mouse as well **which is a consequence of the demand for something else
 
• **Direct demand** is for goods meant for final consumption.
 
• When goods have more than one use, the demand created is known as composite demand.

questions.question: Vijay Hazare was a famous Indian player associated with the sport of ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• Vijay Hazare was a famous Indian player associated with the sport of **Cricket.**__
 
• A trophy called Vijay Hazare Trophy was named after him and started in 2002-03.
 
• Under his captaincy, Indian won the 1st ever test cricket against England in 1951-52.

questions.question: Which economist gave the theory of Opportunity Cost?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Gottfried Haberler**__ gave the theory of Opportunity Cost.
 
• Opportunity cost is the value of the most valuable choice from those which were not taken.
 
• It expresses the basic relation between choice and scarcity.
 
• Gottfried Haberler abandoned the labor theory of value for this concept.

questions.question: The Sepoy Mutiny in India started from ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **The Sepoy Mutiny or Indian Mutiny in India started from Meerut by Indian troops.**__
 
• It was an unsuccessful rebellion during 1857-59 against the British.
 
• It spread to Lucknow, Delhi, Kanpur, and Agra.
 
• It is also called as the First War of Independence.

questions.question: Which of the following is the smallest bird in the world?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Bee Hummingbird**__ is the smallest bird in the world.
 
• It measures 57 mm in total length.
 
• It is slightly larger than a bee and is endemic to Cuba.
 
• Its breeding season is between March and June and its lays 2 eggs at a time.

questions.question: The term 'cherry picking' is used in which sport?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The term 'cherry picking' is used in** basketball.**__
 
• It refers to the play where a cherry picker (player) remains near the opponents' goal and does not play defense with the rest of the team.
 
• It is also used in other sports such as water polo, ice hockey, etc.

questions.question: What is the term of the elected representatives of a Gram Panchayat?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The term of the elected representatives of a Gram Panchayat is **5 years.**__
 
• The Gram Panchayat is divided into wards which is represented by a Commissioner or a ward member, who is also known as Panch.
 
• A Panch is directly elected by the villagers.

questions.question: Which of the following authors received the Jnanpith Award in 2018?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Amitav Ghosh**__ received the 54th Jnanpith Award in 2018 for his outstanding contribution towards literature.
 
• He is known for his novels such as The Hungry Tide, Shadow Lines, etc.
 
• Jnanpith Awards are presented annually Bharatiya Jnanpith.
 
• The award carries a cash prize of Rs.11 lakh.
